observations.body: Jesus answers a challenge with a question about John’s baptism, exposes the leaders’ dilemma, and says tax collectors and prostitutes believed John.
observations.label: Jesus asks where John’s baptism came from

payload.posture: Read Matthew 21:23–32 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus answers a challenge with a question about John’s baptism, exposes the leaders’ dilemma, and says tax collectors and prostitutes believed John. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
payload.title: Jesus asks where John’s baptism came from
